# CANDIDATE: Deferred Chart Wipe and EMA Refresh

**Filed:** 2026-06-29
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger_branch
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

The deferred chart wipe and EMA refresh occur prior to the first heartbeat entry gate, ensuring that the engine has the most up-to-date chart information before making trading decisions.

## Mechanism

The chart wipe and EMA refresh are triggered by the premarket preparation script, which runs at 08:00 ET. The script wipes the chart of any outdated information and recalculates the EMA values using the latest available data.
